bill.title: Heirs Education and Investment to Resolve Succession of Property Act

aiDescription.summary: Reauthorizes USDA’s heirs property relending program to 2031 and funds nonprofit legal and accounting cooperative agreements to resolve ownership and succession of multi‑owner farmland or forestland. Provides $60 million per year for FY2027–2031 (≤3% admin), prioritizes underserved heirs (limited‑resource, socially disadvantaged, veterans), and requires annual public reports to Congress.

impact.summary: The bill reauthorizes heirs property relending and farmland data programs through 2031 and authorizes $60 million annually for USDA cooperative agreements funding nonprofit legal services. It affects underserved heirs with undivided farmland or forest interests, nonprofit legal providers, and USDA programs requiring ownership to enroll.
